summary: Brain strategy defense game to defend a space base
description:
Defend your space base from waves of enemies through air, ground, and air assaults.
Depending on the commander's command, the base can be defended, but it can also be captured.
Protect your space base from invading enemies using various strategies and insights.

[Game operation and method]
- This is a game where you win by building a turret tower and defeating all enemies before you run out of lives.
- After selecting an empty space, you can select a basic turret within the limits of the goods you have.
- You can secure new space by selecting an obstacle and destroying it with a turret within range.
- You cannot attack enemy units while the obstacle is being destroyed, so if you cancel the attack by pressing the obstacle again, you can aim and attack the enemy unit.
- If an enemy unit infiltrates your base and loses all given lives, the mission will fail.

[Introduction to the basic tower]
- Laser Turret: Basic turret with excellent rate of fire
- Plasma Turret: A turret that is a single-shot shell but inflicts strong damage.
- Railgun Turret: A turret that deals damage to both enemies and obstacles pierced by a penetrating beam.
- EMP Core: Turret that reduces enemy movement speed
- Sensor Tower: A turret that increases the range of nearby attack turrets.

[Game Features]
- Build turret towers on numerous unique maps to create a variety of defense strategies.
- You can face large numbers of enemies or compete with other users in endless mode.
- Provides additional fun through a differentiated random card placement game.
- You can select the desired camera view and change the game speed to 2x or 3x.
- Build your own tower with a variety of tech tree upgrades.
- You can receive additional damage or compensation by strengthening your skill card.
- Challenge the weekly leaderboard that resets every week and become the world's strongest!
- No action required, allowing unlimited game play.
- You can play the game even without Wi-Fi.
